notes: Native masks preserved; no replacement values written to original rasters
Global model is regional display context, not reef-scale sounding coverage

displayRules: Inspection retains unblended nearest displayed source samples and source class.
Fine display spacing does not improve native source resolution.
Normals and source transitions are smoothed for display; no rocks or fish locations are invented.
Morro Bay lidar land and bottom share NAVD88; offshore survey output reference remains unresolved.
A zero/adjustable water display surface is not an observed tide.
Regional model is used outside detailed survey support, including beyond 300ft.
